about: Lunar artificial impacts with independently known impactor mass, speed and elevation and a measured crater (built by audit/research/experiments/s40i/build_spacecraft_impacts.py from the pre-registered session-10 anchor set; sources per event in 'source', reading depth in audit/research/lit_s10/artificial_impacts_sources.md). All are hollow, slow (1.6-2.9 km/s) spacecraft: outside the compact hypervelocity regime of point-source scaling. 'held_out' is true only for events that no session had examined before the test was run.

events.label: Apollo 13 S-IVB
events.development_use: sigma_mf = 0.10 dex was set in session 3 (experiment E1) with knowledge of this crater. All 11 anchors were examined in sessions 10-40 and fit the opt-in SIGMA_MF_ARTIFICIAL table (engine/calibration.py), which is not a default.
